title: Finite constructible stratifications with a local property glue over a qcqs base
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and suppose there is a finite affine open covering $X=\bigcup_aW_a$ such that, for every $a$, a finite partition $W_a=\coprod_bW_{a,b}$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] has each base change $U\times_XW_{a,b}\to W_{a,b}$ finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Then $X$ has a finite partition $X=\coprod_iX_i$ by constructible locally closed subschemes such that every base change $U\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is finite etale. All fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, second paragraph, line 12045 ('In general, we may assume X is affine'); the finite-intersection/disjointization construction is deferred to the split of this node

proof.text: For each chart W_a contained in X, first note that W_a is quasi-compact because it is affine. Since X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-scheme-spectral] gives a spectral space, whose definition [def-weil-spectral-space] includes a basis of quasi-compact opens, and [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-open-retrocompact-iff-quasi-compact] shows that the open W_a is retrocompact. Therefore its closed complement is constructible by [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Each local W_{a,b}, constructible in the retrocompact open W_a, is constructible in X by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-in-retrocompact-open]; composing its immersion into W_a with the open immersion W_a to X makes it a locally closed subscheme of X. Add the closed complement as one further stratum, giving it a closed subscheme structure by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-closed-subscheme]. Thus each chart produces a finite stratification of X by constructible locally closed subschemes: the local pieces cover W_a and the complement covers the rest.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9, proof, locality reduction; the complement and subscheme structures are made explicit here

proof.text: Iterate [lemma-constructible-common-refinement] over the finitely many chart stratifications. The resulting finite partition $(X_i)_i$ is constructible and locally closed, and each $X_i$ is contained in one member of every chart stratification. Since the $W_a$ cover $X$, each $X_i$ is contained in some $W_a$ rather than in its complement; for that $a$ it is therefore contained in one of the local pieces $W_{a,b}$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9, proof, second paragraph: finite intersections and disjointization of the local stratifications

proof.text: Fix an underlying stratum X_i and choose a,b with X_i contained in W_{a,b}. Define Z_i = X_i fibre-product over X with W_{a,b}, with its induced fibre-product scheme structure and actual projections p_i : Z_i\to X_i and q_i : Z_i\to W_{a,b}. The map $p_i$ is the base change of the immersion $W_{a,b}\to X$ along $X_i\to X$, hence an immersion [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-base-change-lft] (1); composed with the immersion $X_i\to X$ it makes $Z_i\to X$ an immersion [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence] (e), whose image is $X_i\cap W_{a,b}=X_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-base-change-image]; use $Z_i$ as the scheme representative of this stratum (same underlying set, so the $Z_i$ still form a finite partition by constructible locally closed subschemes). Pull back the finite morphism from U fibre-product over X with W_{a,b} to W_{a,b} along q_i; it is finite by base-change permanence (a) in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence], and etale by the Mathlib-backed base-change node [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]. Fibre-product associativity identifies the resulting source with U fibre-product over X with Z_i, so this map is finite etale over the stratum Z_i. Relabeling Z_i as X_i gives the required global partition.

lean.statement: theorem exists_constructible_stratification_finite_etale_of_affine_local {X U : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U] (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] (hlocal : ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens), (∀ a : Fin n, IsAffineOpen (W a)) ∧ (⋃ a : Fin n, (W a : Set X)) = Set.univ ∧ ∀ a : Fin n, ∃ S : LocallyClosedStratification (W a), (∀ b : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum b)) ∧ ∀ b : Fin S.n, IsFinite (pullback.snd j (S.immersion b ≫ (W a).ι)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd j (S.immersion b ≫ (W a).ι))) : ∃ S : LocallyClosedStratification X, (∀ i : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum i)) ∧ ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFinite (pullback.snd j (S.immersion i)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd j (S.immersion i))
